products_price_check.name: products_price_check
products_price_check.value: "products"."price_cents" >= 0 AND ("products"."happy_hour_price_cents" IS NULL OR "products"."happy_hour_price_cents" BETWEEN 0 AND "products"."price_cents")

products_abv_check.name: products_abv_check
products_abv_check.value: "products"."abv" IS NULL OR ("products"."kind" = 'drink' AND "products"."abv" BETWEEN 0 AND 100)
